_about: Local additions and deviations layered on top of tokens.json. tokens.json is a byte-exact mirror of the Claude Design system and is never hand-edited. Every entry here needs a reason and a status. 'pending-upstream' means it should be proposed as a change to the Claude Design system; once it lands there, delete it here.

tokens.name: input-border
tokens.reason: border-strong (#94a3b8) is 2.6:1 on white, below the WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 3:1 floor for control boundaries. #64748b is 4.75:1.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.reason: Secondary buttons, chips and other controls outlined in border-strong (#94a3b8) are 2.6:1 on white, below the WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 3:1 floor. #64748b is 4.75:1, the same value as input-border. Rob approved 2026-09-29.

tokens.name: input-fill
tokens.reason: Rob asked for text boxes with a consistent background shade that makes them easy to find (2026-09-25). Reuses the surface-hover value; fields turn surface (#ffffff) on focus.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.reason: Career Explorer Coach exemplar (v1.3.0): shared side padding for header, step header, feed and composer. ecc-app.css drops it to 16px under 640px and 12px at 375px and below.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.reason: Career Explorer Coach exemplar (v1.3.0): fixed column, never over 280px, drawer under 900px.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.reason: Page background. Green-gray so white cards stand out (was #f8fafc). Ink on it is 16.41:1. ECC v2 (bolder color, larger desktop UI for mentors in their 60s and 70s). Rob approved 2026-10-23 after the ENS 101 redesign review.
